idea.summary: Old-school stranger chat opened with 'asl?'; now you skip the typing and just hear a voice, shown as a then-vs-now versus and a call with a stranger who still says it.

post.caption:
Omegle is gone, but meeting someone totally random still feels great. This time it's just voices. What was your first message to a stranger?

Try it at randomtalker.com
